facts.statement: Four variations of Mother's Day bouquets became available in the Marketplace with this update.
facts.quote: Four variations of Mother's Day bouquets are now available.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This official web page lists the new features in the Free Realms update of May 6, 2010: Mother's Day bouquets, purchasable bags of in-game coin with Station Cash, six new non-combat job wieldables on the SC Market, a new White Nose Stallion ride in six colors, and a combined jobs/equipment selection screen. The article gives no prices, counts of bouquet variants beyond four, or quantities of coin.
